notes.title: Dungeon and Craft - Ultimate Update
notes.content:
Hello, I hope you are in a good mood. With this update, some new features have been added to the game.

Let me start with the least complicated one first, the game will automatically save every time you complete a dungeon or die in a dungeon. In this way, the save problem will be minimized. 
Some balance changes for the final boss.

Now we come to explain Ultimate Attack:

In each round in the dungeon, you will collect the points required for the ultimate attack according to the dungeon tier. When you collect 800 points, you will be able to use your ultimate attack to slash creatures. (You must have 1600 points for the final boss and +800 points for each use.)

Ultimate Attack destroys everything in one hit, except the final bosses (including shots from ranged enemies).

Remember to increase the cooldown to increase the duration of the Ultimate Attack and increase your movement speed to make it attack faster.

Sincerely,
Musa GUNGOR

notes.title: Dungeon and Craft - Demo Changes
notes.content:
Hi, I wanted to post an update as the old demo version is way behind the current version of the game.

With this update ;

* Menu background and buttons
* Weapon hit effects 
* New hud with lives, exp and potions
* Boosts that appear between rounds in the Dungeon area
* Changes to gameplay balance and some mechanics

And many changes I can't remember were added to the demo version. If you want to test the new version with all the changes, please start the game with a new save.

Sincerely,
Musa GUNGOR
